title: Generator Safety
description: Carbon monoxide is the main danger: where to place a generator, why open doors don't make indoor use safe, CO alarms, and what to do if one sounds or someone feels sick. Covers backfeeding and transfer switches, extension cords, refueling, and load management.
shortDescription: Outdoors 20+ ft from the house, CO alarms and symptoms, and never backfeeding
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
